case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner

Dear partner,

Thank you for your revised offer and your continued movement. Please note that a 28-day lead time is the absolute minimum we can provide to ensure our quality standards. Any further step needs approval from our management.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We are pleased to present our offer of a price of €17.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

We remain eager to work together and look forward to building a successful long-term partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
